name: Bread from Manitoba Flour
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: In the morning sift flour into your bread pan
Take 3 quarts of warm water to 1 quart of yeast, 2 tablespoons sugar, 3 tablespoons salt
Mix to consistency of a nice soft dough
Punch for half an hour, gradually sifting flour till you have a nice, smooth, spongy dough
Let rise and mix down twice
Put in the pans and let rise for an hour

source.originalInstructions:
1. In the morning sift flour into your bread pan
2. Take 3 quarts of warm water to 1 quart of yeast, 2 tablespoons sugar, 3 tablespoons salt
3. Mix to consistency of a nice soft dough
4. Punch for half an hour, gradually sifting flour till you have a nice, smooth, spongy dough
5. Let rise and mix down twice
6. Put in the pans and let rise for an hour
7. Bake in oven
